tools.name: refund_order_and_notify_buyer
tools.description: Refunds a ticket order through the payment processor and emails the buyer a refund confirmation. Records the refund against the order in the database.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the ticket order to refund

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for the refund shown to the buyer

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

import stripe

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
DB = os.environ.get("TICKETS_DB", "tickets.db")


def _send(to, subj, body):
    m = EmailMessage()
    m["From"] = "tickets@example.com"
    m["To"] = to
    m["Subject"] = subj
    m.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "localhost"), 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.login(os.environ["SMTP_USER"], os.environ["SMTP_PASS"])
        s.send_message(m)


def refund_order_and_notify_buyer(order_id: str, reason: str = "requested_by_customer"):
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT charge_id, email, total_cents, status, event_name FROM orders WHERE id = ?",
        (order_id,),
    )
    r = cur.fetchone()
    if not r:
        con.close()
        return {"ok": False, "error": "order not found"}
    cid, email, amt, st, ev = r
    if st == "refunded":
        con.close()
        return {"ok": False, "error": "already refunded"}
    if not cid:
        con.close()
        return {"ok": False, "error": "no charge on order"}
    try:
        rf = stripe.Refund.create(
            charge=cid,
            amount=amt,
            metadata={"order_id": order_id, "note": reason},
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as e:
        con.close()
        return {"ok": False, "error": str(e)}
    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE orders SET status = 'refunded', refund_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (rf.id, order_id),
    )
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    amt_s = "%.2f" % (amt / 100)
    body = (
        "Your order %s for %s has been refunded.\n"
        "Amount: $%s\nReason: %s\n"
    ) % (order_id, ev, amt_s, reason)
    try:
        _send(email, "Refund confirmation for order %s" % order_id, body)
        sent = True
    except Exception:
        sent = False
    return {"ok": True, "refund_id": rf.id, "amount": amt, "email_sent": sent}

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event to import attendees into

params.name: csv_path
params.description: Path to the attendee CSV file

tools.code:
import subprocess
import tempfile


def run_attendee_import_job(event_id: str, csv_path: str):
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode="w+") as log:
        p = subprocess.run(
            ["python", "scripts/import_attendees.py", "--event", event_id, "--csv", csv_path],
            stdout=log,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            timeout=600,
        )
        log.seek(0)
        out = log.read()
    return {"returncode": p.returncode, "log": out[-2000:]}

tools.name: purchase_tickets_from_wallet
tools.description: Looks up the ticket price for an event tier and charges the buyer's account balance for the requested quantity of tickets.
tools.code:
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing")
BILLING_URL = "https://billing.internal.example.com"
CATALOG_URL = "https://catalog.internal.example.com"


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_tickets_from_wallet(event_id: str, tier: str, quantity: int, account_id: str) -> dict:
    price_response = requests.get(f"{CATALOG_URL}/events/{event_id}/tiers/{tier}", timeout=10)
    price_response.raise_for_status()
    unit_price_in_cents = price_response.json()["price_cents"]
    total_charge_in_cents = unit_price_in_cents * quantity
    charge_response = requests.post(
        f"{BILLING_URL}/wallets/{account_id}/debit",
        json={"amount_cents": total_charge_in_cents, "memo": f"{quantity} x {tier} for {event_id}"},
        timeout=10,
    )
    charge_response.raise_for_status()
    return {"charged_cents": total_charge_in_cents, "transaction": charge_response.json()}
